metadata.description: Agent plugins for OpenCode, Claude Code, OMP and pi.

plugins.name: agent-mechanic
plugins.description: mechanic subagent: cheap, exact mechanical edits (renames, bulk edits, formatting, moving code) that run the given check.

plugins.name: agent-researcher
plugins.description: The researcher subagent: answers one scoped question from code, docs and the web with cited observations and inferences, and records it on a bead when given one.

plugins.name: agent-reviewer
plugins.description: A security review skill: trace untrusted input to sinks, tag CWE ids and check cross-boundary dispatch.

plugins.name: architecture
plugins.description: Architecture skills: capability-first top-level layout, ownership boundaries, and durable docs/ project knowledge.

plugins.name: build
plugins.description: External-repository worker subagent: clone, follow the target's conventions, edit, verify, and publish only when delegated.

plugins.name: code-challenge
plugins.description: Challenge code for simplification, performance, stability, hand-rolled code and structure, with evidence for every finding.

plugins.name: debate
plugins.description: Stress-test a decision from both sides, grill a plan in frontier rounds, or write a questionnaire for someone else.

plugins.name: eli5
plugins.description: Explain a topic at five depth levels, from metaphor to frontier.

plugins.name: lang-go
plugins.description: Go skills: build, lint, go test -race, tidy and govulncheck checks, testing and fuzzing, module and package layout, and pprof profiling.

plugins.name: lang-python
plugins.description: Python skills: uv, ruff, mypy or pyright and pytest checks, testing, packaging, typing and pydantic, SQLAlchemy and Alembic, and profiling.

plugins.name: lang-rust
plugins.description: Rust skills: fmt, clippy and test checks, testing with nextest, proptest and insta, crates and workspaces, CI, sqlx persistence, Tauri and profiling.

plugins.name: lang-typescript
plugins.description: TypeScript and JavaScript skills: install, lint, tsc and test checks, testing, monorepo packaging, type safety and zod, and Bun and Node profiling.

plugins.name: modes
plugins.description: Debug, refactor and concept agents with plan-style mode reminders: root-cause diagnosis in a scratch worktree, behaviour-preserving refactoring, and design iteration.

plugins.name: project
plugins.description: Project lifecycle: scaffold a project with /new-project and pick an OSI-approved license.

plugins.name: project-secrets
plugins.description: Per-project secrets with fnox and 1Password: store, use, inspect and rotate them with no value in the transcript.

plugins.name: toolchain
plugins.description: Toolchain defaults as skills: stack, frontend, infrastructure, languages, observability, shell, Terraform, caches, background jobs and worktree coexistence.
